findings.statement: Freshness and retained context matter across tasks and changing sources.
findings.rationale: Conservative reconciliation and recovery complement existing pins and expiry.

findings.statement: Upstream efficiency numbers might transfer to this system.

requirements.statement: Explain the graph purpose and structural/operational memory within the first 100 skill lines.
Retrieve relevant bounded context, reuse unchanged lookups and inspect unresolved/current sources.
Learn relevant reusable nonduplicate evidence with one useful question per record and honest diagnostic status.
Preserve current-source authority, conservative invalidation, history and non-reconstructible memory.
Report no qualifying learning honestly; judge useful reuse rather than activity or unmeasured gain.
